decisions.reason: As a multi-model formwork system very close to the firm's core offer, supported by its own R&D and modular engineering capabilities, Product A fits knowledge the firm can improve and is therefore unlikely to be withdrawn soon.

Product C is also close to the established formwork business and offered as a product line, so the firm has strong absorptive capacity to refine it, though its lower website prominence suggests a slightly higher withdrawal risk than A.

Because Product E is closely related to the firm's existing magnetic formwork and automation portfolio and was given its own page, management would likely keep it and continue learning from the market rather than exit quickly.

Although Product F is near the firm's core knowledge base, its more limited website presence and narrower scope make it the most expendable of the four, but the firm's R&D strength still makes continued commercialization more likely than dropping it.
